title: De novo protein binders to the Csy4 crRNA hairpin: pipeline archive
description:
As-run code archive for the computational arm of the thesis De novo design of RNA-binding proteins targeting the Csy4 crRNA hairpin: five generative design stacks, three structure re-prediction backends, the interface metric suite computed over them, and the filter cascade that reduced 6,992,515 designs to the 12,000-member library sent to synthesis.

This is a snapshot of the production tree at the computational data freeze, not a reconstructed history: every configuration file is the file that ran. It documents the pipeline but will not regenerate the dataset, because no stack used is seed-reproducible at the level of an individual design. See README.md for what the archive can and cannot do, and provenance/ for container digests, environment manifests, the selection gate and the recorded deviations.

Code is MIT-licensed; deposited data is CC-BY-4.0. Third-party tools (RFdiffusion3, BoltzGen, BoltzDesign1, LigandMPNN, AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, ESM, DockQ, PyRosetta, PyFurnace) carry their own licences and are neither included nor redistributed here.
